category_title: Verbal student with ASD and hyperactivity with high musical engagement and sensitivity to stimuli
scenario_title: Learning a new song in group music class
minimal_context: The student is in a group music culture class learning to sing a new song and remember its melody.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Class, we are going to learn a new song today. Please listen to the melody and try to remember it.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Keeps his attention focused on the teacher and the musical activities.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now try to sing the first line of the new song with me.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Instead of the new song, he performs a song by a different artist that he knows by heart.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please stop singing that song. We need to practice the new one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Approaches the teacher, tells them what he has in mind, and immediately runs away without waiting for a reaction. He goes to the other students, addresses them by their first names, and calls them to come and play "hunting" with him.)

TUTOR: Class, we are going to learn a new song today. Please listen to the melody and try to remember it.

STUDENT: (Approaches the teacher, tells them what he has in mind, and immediately runs away without waiting for a reaction. He goes to the other students, addresses them by their first names, and calls them to come and play "hunting" with him.)
